_about: Data catalog for openQ's table schemas: one entry per (schema, table) with a plain-English description of the table and every column, plus its kdb+ type. Curated alongside schemas/*.q and core/housekeeping.q; keep in sync when a schema column changes. Consumed by openDash/gateway (/api/catalog -> the dashboard's Data > Catalog page).

groups.name: HDB-eq
groups.desc: On-disk equities market data from the real Yahoo Finance ingest pipeline (schema_eq.q; C:/data/db1/eq).

groups.name: In-Memory Markout
groups.desc: Live markout module ingest (schema_markout.q) — analysed in the RDB/CEP, HDB mostly empty.

groups.name: Demo-eq
groups.desc: Example tables shipped with openQ — the generic default pipeline (schema.q), not a real production dataset.

tables.name: quote
tables.desc: Generic top-of-book quote — one row per market-data update on the default demo pipeline. Every openQ table leads with timestamp,sym (enforced by tp.q's .u.tick).

columns.name: timestamp
columns.desc: Tickerplant receipt time (UTC). Mandatory first column; drives per-sym partitioning, replay and grouped/parted attributes.

columns.name: bidSize
columns.desc: Size available at the best bid.

columns.name: askSize
columns.desc: Size available at the best ask.

columns.name: source
columns.desc: Feed / venue the quote came from.

tables.name: trade
tables.desc: Generic trade print on the default demo pipeline — one row per execution.

columns.name: side
columns.desc: Aggressor side — `buy / `sell (where the feed reports it).

columns.name: source
columns.desc: Feed / venue the print came from.

tables.name: trade
tables.desc: Trade stream feeding the markout module's modules/analytics/markout/markOutImpact.q. timestamp -> tradeTime, price -> tradeRate in the library.

columns.name: tradeID
columns.desc: Unique trade identifier, used to correlate a fill with its later markout samples.

tables.name: order
tables.desc: Order stream feeding the markout module. timestamp -> orderTime, price -> orderRate; drives .impact.onBook's arrival-price capture.

columns.name: orderID
columns.desc: Unique order identifier; keys the pending-impact state until the order's decay window closes.

columns.name: price
columns.desc: Order (limit / arrival) rate; the library's orderRate.

columns.name: side
columns.desc: Order side — `buy / `sell; sets the sign of the impact measure.

tables.name: rate
tables.desc: Reference mid-rate feed. Both .markout.onRate and .impact.onBook match trades / orders against this series; also the price source for the dashboard's eFX > Charts (OHLC).

columns.name: mid
columns.desc: Mid rate at that instant — the benchmark markout and impact are measured relative to.

tables.name: spreadQuote
tables.desc: One row per priced quote, already decomposed by the pricing engine into its seven named build-up components (matches modules/analytics/spread/spread.q's .spread.quote). Component values are price fractions; the dashboard reports them in bps (x1e4).

columns.name: aggression
columns.desc: Client aggression bucket — `low / `medium / `high; a regime dimension for by-regime aggregation.

columns.name: marketStatus
columns.desc: Market regime — `normal / `stressed; the other regime dimension.

columns.name: weight
columns.desc: Row weight for the engine's weighted averages (typically notional or a confidence weight).

columns.name: refSprd
columns.desc: Reference spread — the raw market spread the quote starts from.

columns.name: baseSprd
columns.desc: Base house spread added on top of the reference.

columns.name: clientSprd
columns.desc: Client-tier adjustment (tighter or wider by relationship / flow quality).

columns.name: smoothSprd
columns.desc: Smoothing / hysteresis term that damps quote-to-quote jitter.

columns.name: fallbackSprd
columns.desc: Fallback widening applied when a primary input is stale or missing.

columns.name: alphaSprd
columns.desc: Alpha / skew term from the engine's short-term directional signal.

tables.name: inventory
tables.desc: Borrowable-supply snapshots per (symbol, lender) for the securities-finance / prime module.

columns.name: lender
columns.desc: Lending counterparty / desk offering the supply.

columns.name: available
columns.desc: Quantity currently available to borrow from this lender.

columns.name: feeBp
columns.desc: Indicative borrow fee, annualised basis points.

columns.name: termDays
columns.desc: Offered term length in days (0 = open / overnight).

columns.name: recallRisk
columns.desc: Probability-style score (0-1) that this supply gets recalled early.

columns.name: counterpartyRisk
columns.desc: Credit / concentration risk score (0-1) for the lender.

columns.name: minLot
columns.desc: Minimum borrow size the lender will transact.

tables.name: locate
tables.desc: Locate requests and their allocation status — the demand side of coverage.

columns.name: requested
columns.desc: Quantity the client asked to locate.

columns.name: expiry
columns.desc: When the locate reservation lapses if unused.

tables.name: position
tables.desc: Client short positions that create the borrow requirement.

columns.name: qty
columns.desc: Signed position quantity (negative = short — the side that needs coverage).

tables.name: borrow
tables.desc: Open stock-borrow contracts covering short positions.

columns.name: feeBp
columns.desc: Contracted borrow fee, annualised basis points.

tables.name: recall
tables.desc: Recall notices from lenders — supply being pulled back, which can force a buy-in.

columns.name: due
columns.desc: Deadline to return the stock before a buy-in is triggered.

tables.name: logs
tables.desc: Central log table: every process that loads core/utils/logToTab.q and connects to the mon tickerplant publishes one row per log line here, with a full banner so it can be queried like a merged log file across the estate.

columns.name: handle
columns.desc: IPC handle the row was published on (.z.w).

columns.name: user
columns.desc: OS user the process runs as (.z.u).

columns.name: mem
columns.desc: Process heap used at log time, MB (.Q.w[]`used).

columns.name: code
columns.desc: Caller-supplied event code (e.g. `.report.refresh) — a stable key for filtering.

tables.name: pidstats
tables.desc: One row per (host, pid) per poll from modules/mon/pidstat_poller.py (or the Node stand-in), combining `pidstat -u` (CPU) and `pidstat -r` (memory).

columns.name: sym
columns.desc: Monitored openQ process's -name; blank for a non-openQ process on the host.

columns.name: pidstatTime
columns.desc: pidstat's own sample timestamp — when the metrics were measured, vs `timestamp which is when the TP received them.

columns.name: uid
columns.desc: OS user id owning the process.

columns.name: procType
columns.desc: openQ role (tp/rdb/hdb/gw/cep/idb...) — populated only when the command line carries -procType; null for initFromCfg.q launches.

columns.name: port
columns.desc: openQ listen port — populated only when the command line carries -port; null otherwise.

columns.name: userPct
columns.desc: % CPU in user space over the interval.

columns.name: cpuPct
columns.desc: Total % of one core used (user + sys + guest).

columns.name: cpuId
columns.desc: Which logical CPU the process last ran on.

columns.name: rss
columns.desc: Resident set size, KB — real physical memory.

columns.name: memPct
columns.desc: RSS as % of total machine RAM.

columns.name: command
columns.desc: Full raw command line — always the complete picture even when procType/port couldn't be parsed.

tables.name: tableHealth
tables.desc: Output of examples/scripts/05_table_health_scan.q (.oq.hk.scanHDB) for the BAR-level tables of an on-disk HDB: one row per (table, date) scanned, with that table's whole-history summary repeated on every row. Persisted under -monroot; backs the dashboard's HDB Health page.

columns.name: sym
columns.desc: Caller-supplied identifier for the scanned HDB / deployment (-name).

columns.name: tab
columns.desc: Name of the table this row describes.

columns.name: role
columns.desc: Always `hdb — this scan only ever reads on-disk history.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: The partition date this row describes.

columns.name: rowCountToday
columns.desc: Exact row count in this date's partition.

columns.name: rowCountTotal
columns.desc: Exact row count across every partition the table has — repeated on each of its date rows.

columns.name: firstTime
columns.desc: Earliest row timestamp in this date's partition.

columns.name: lastTime
columns.desc: Latest row timestamp in this date's partition.

columns.name: ageSec
columns.desc: now - lastTime in seconds — a staleness signal for the newest partition.

columns.name: bytesMem
columns.desc: Always null here — in-memory footprint only applies to a live rdb/cep.

columns.name: bytesDisk
columns.desc: On-disk bytes of this (table, date) partition directory.

columns.name: partitionCnt
columns.desc: How many dates the table has any partition for, across its whole history — repeated per row.

columns.name: oldestDate
columns.desc: Earliest partition date in the table's history — repeated per row.

columns.name: newestDate
columns.desc: Latest partition date in the table's history — repeated per row.

columns.name: status
columns.desc: `HEALTHY (this date has rows) or `EMPTY (no partition, or an empty one).

tables.name: tableHealthTick
tables.desc: Identical shape to tableHealth, produced by a separate scan pass over the TICK-level tables (higher volume) so the two land as distinct tables side by side under one -monroot.

columns.name: sym
columns.desc: Caller-supplied identifier for the scanned HDB / deployment.

columns.name: tab
columns.desc: Name of the tick-level table this row describes.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: The partition date this row describes.

columns.name: rowCountToday
columns.desc: Exact row count in this date's partition.

columns.name: rowCountTotal
columns.desc: Exact row count across every partition — repeated per row.

columns.name: firstTime
columns.desc: Earliest row timestamp in this partition.

columns.name: lastTime
columns.desc: Latest row timestamp in this partition.

columns.name: bytesDisk
columns.desc: On-disk bytes of this (table, date) partition.

columns.name: partitionCnt
columns.desc: Count of dates the table has any partition for — repeated per row.

columns.name: oldestDate
columns.desc: Earliest partition date — repeated per row.

columns.name: newestDate
columns.desc: Latest partition date — repeated per row.

tables.name: fx_tick_massive
tables.desc: Tick-level FX quotes from the 'massive' vendor feed in an existing on-disk archive (C:/data/db1/efx). Read-only integration — openQ never writes here.

columns.name: ask_exchange
columns.desc: Numeric venue id for the ask side.

columns.name: bid_exchange
columns.desc: Numeric venue id for the bid side.

tables.name: fx_tick_dukasCopy
tables.desc: Tick-level FX quotes from the 'dukasCopy' vendor feed, which also carries per-side volume and string venue codes.

columns.name: ask_exchange
columns.desc: Venue code for the ask side.

columns.name: bid_exchange
columns.desc: Venue code for the bid side.

tables.name: fx_m1_massive
tables.desc: 1-minute OHLC bars from the 'massive' vendor feed.

columns.name: transactions
columns.desc: Number of ticks / trades aggregated into the bar.

tables.name: fx_m1_dukasCopy
tables.desc: 1-minute OHLC bars from the 'dukasCopy' vendor feed.

columns.name: volume
columns.desc: Total volume in the bar (fractional in this feed).

columns.name: ask_exchange
columns.desc: Venue code for the ask side.

columns.name: bid_exchange
columns.desc: Venue code for the bid side.

tables.name: fx_d1_massive
tables.desc: Daily OHLC bars from the 'massive' vendor feed.

columns.name: transactions
columns.desc: Number of ticks / trades aggregated into the day.

tables.name: eq_d1_yfinance
tables.desc: Daily OHLCV bars for US equities (NYSE + Nasdaq) from the stockData project's Yahoo Finance loader. Date-partitioned archive at C:/data/db1/eq (2010 -> present); read-only, openQ never writes it. No `timestamp column — the partition date is the only time key, and `sym is `p (parted) on disk.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: The bar's trading day. Virtual column from the on-disk date partitioning — there is no stored timestamp.

columns.name: sym
columns.desc: Ticker symbol. Parted (`p) attribute on disk.

columns.name: volume
columns.desc: Total shares traded on the day.

tables.name: eq_m1_yfinance
tables.desc: 1-minute OHLCV bars for Asian-market equities — Hong Kong (HKEX) and Tokyo / TSE (Nikkei) — from the yfinance intraday loader. Date-partitioned at C:/data/db1/eq alongside eq_d1_yfinance; read-only, openQ never writes it. Rolling ~1-month window only (Yahoo serves at most ~30 days of 1-minute history). Unlike eq_d1_yfinance this table carries a real `timestamp (openQ's mandatory tp,sym-first column) as well as `barTime, the minute the bar covers; `sym is `p (parted) on disk.

columns.name: date
columns.desc: Trading day. Virtual column from the on-disk date partitioning.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.desc: Row ingest time (UTC) — the mandatory openQ first column. Close to, but not identical to, `barTime.

columns.name: sym
columns.desc: Yahoo-style ticker — e.g. `0001.HK (Hong Kong), `1301.T (Tokyo). Parted (`p) on disk.

columns.name: barTime
columns.desc: Start of the 1-minute interval the OHLCV values cover, in exchange local session time. Minutes with no prints for a symbol are simply absent.

columns.name: open
columns.desc: First trade price in the minute.

columns.name: high
columns.desc: Highest trade price in the minute.

columns.name: low
columns.desc: Lowest trade price in the minute.

columns.name: close
columns.desc: Last trade price in the minute.
